commands.checks: Exhaustive census of every vector in {0,...,5}^6 and every centre letter with room for one more call, restricted to prefix sum 21. Expect 120 legal centres on the adjacent pair (21, 22), split 60 of shape (0,3,3,5,5,5) and 60 of shape (2,3,3,3,5,5), all weight 3, with 300 coordinates equal to 10, minimum 2 and maximum 3. The nonnegative case split has exactly the solutions (n0,n3,n5)=(0,2,3) at centre count 0 and (0,3,2) at centre count 2. Every feasible one-step letter pair is realized by a floor word: 540 legal images, 360 stationary and 180 moving, none moving a coordinate 10. Controls: a sum-21 near miss, the eight sum-43 slots and the unique adjacent pair, a length-14 vector that contains a 5, the shape-0 witness word, the shape-2 witness word, and a count-feasible subtraction of a 10 that leaves A.
Same census under optimized Python. Failures are explicit exceptions, not assertions.
